title: For a notification with a job progress graph, "Details" button moves around when clicked
line: Clicking Details on a file copy notification no longer makes the button jump below the speed graph: the progress bar and buttons stay put and the graph opens underneath.
explanation: SpeedChart.qml held both the progress bar and the speed chart and swapped one for the other when Details was checked. It sat above the button row in JobItem.qml, so expanding replaced the one-line progress bar with the 10-gridUnit chart and pushed the Details, Pause and Cancel buttons down under it (and hid the percentage). The change moves the progress bar row into JobItem above the buttons, where it always stays, and puts the chart-only SpeedChart below the button row, above the Source/Destination details, as the text details always appeared.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: keep job Details button in place when expanding

Expanding a job notification replaced its progress bar with the taller
speed chart above the buttons, so the Details button jumped down below
it. Keep the progress bar above the buttons and show the chart below.

BUG: 526902

patches.diff:
From 51c9748fd985a7e45865d9c4f5f53d73601c5013 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 00:52:55 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/notifications: keep job Details button in place when
 expanding

Expanding a job notification replaced its progress bar with the taller
speed chart above the buttons, so the Details button jumped down below
it. Keep the progress bar above the buttons and show the chart below.

BUG: 526902
---
 applets/notifications/components/JobItem.qml  | 48 +++++++++++++++++--
 .../notifications/components/SpeedChart.qml   | 41 +---------------
 2 files changed, 46 insertions(+), 43 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/notifications/components/JobItem.qml b/applets/notifications/components/JobItem.qml
index 3e0efe8c39..cfbdf4fbc0 100644
--- a/applets/notifications/components/JobItem.qml
+++ b/applets/notifications/components/JobItem.qml
@@ -34,11 +34,40 @@ ColumnLayout {
         url: jobItem.totalFiles === 1 ? jobItem.modelInterface.jobDetails.effectiveDestUrl : ""
     }
 
-    SpeedChart {
-        id: speedChart
+    RowLayout {
+        id: progressRow
         Layout.fillWidth: true
-        modelInterface: jobItem.modelInterface
-        expanded: expandButton.checked
+        // Even when indeterminate, we want to reserve the height for the text, otherwise it's too tightly spaced
+        Layout.minimumHeight: progressText.implicitHeight
+        // We want largeSpacing between the progress bar and the label
+        spacing: Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing
+
+        PlasmaComponents3.ProgressBar {
+            id: progressBar
+
+            Layout.fillWidth: true
+
+            from: 0
+            to: 100
+            value: jobItem.modelInterface.percentage
+            // TODO do we actually need the window visible check? perhaps I do because it can be in popup or expanded plasmoid
+            indeterminate: visible && Window.window && Window.window.visible && jobItem.modelInterface.percentage < 1
+                           && jobItem.modelInterface.jobState === NotificationManager.Notifications.JobStateRunning
+                           // is this too annoying?
+                           && (jobItem.modelInterface.jobDetails?.processedBytes === 0 || jobItem.modelInterface.jobDetails?.totalBytes === 0)
+                           && jobItem.modelInterface.jobDetails?.processedFiles === 0
+                           //&& modelInterface.jobDetails.processedDirectories === 0
+        }
+
+        PlasmaComponents3.Label {
+            id: progressText
+
+            visible: !progressBar.indeterminate
+            // the || "0" is a workaround for the fact that 0 as number is falsey, and is wrongly considered a missing argument
+            // BUG: 451807
+            text: i18ndc("plasma_applet_org.kde.plasma.notifications", "Percentage of a job", "%1%", jobItem.modelInterface.percentage || "0")
+            textFormat: Text.PlainText
+        }
     }
 
     RowLayout {
@@ -95,6 +124,13 @@ ColumnLayout {
         }
     }
 
+    SpeedChart {
+        id: speedChart
+        Layout.fillWidth: true
+        modelInterface: jobItem.modelInterface
+        expanded: expandButton.checked
+    }
+
     Loader {
         Layout.fillWidth: true
         Layout.preferredWidth: Notifications.Globals.popupWidth
@@ -182,11 +218,15 @@ ColumnLayout {
         State {
             when: jobItem.modelInterface.jobState === NotificationManager.Notifications.JobStateSuspended
             PropertyChanges {
+                progressRow.enabled: false
                 speedChart.enabled: false
             }
         },
         State {
             when: jobItem.modelInterface.jobState === NotificationManager.Notifications.JobStateStopped
+            PropertyChanges {
+                progressRow.visible: false
+            }
             PropertyChanges {
                 speedChart.visible: false
             }
diff --git a/applets/notifications/components/SpeedChart.qml b/applets/notifications/components/SpeedChart.qml
index 7687ab2128..80c0a9f2ed 100644
--- a/applets/notifications/components/SpeedChart.qml
+++ b/applets/notifications/components/SpeedChart.qml
@@ -12,7 +12,6 @@ import QtQuick.Layouts
 
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 import org.kde.coreaddons as KCoreAddons
-import org.kde.notificationmanager as NotificationManager
 import org.kde.plasma.components as PlasmaComponents3
 
 import org.kde.quickcharts as Charts
@@ -77,9 +76,8 @@ Item {
         return values;
     }
 
-    Layout.minimumHeight: chartContainer.active ? Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 10 :
-        // Even when indeterminate, we want to reserve the height for the text, otherwise it's too tightly spaced
-        progressText.implicitHeight
+    implicitHeight: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 10
+    visible: chartContainer.active
 
     Layout.fillWidth: true
 
@@ -266,39 +264,4 @@ Item {
             }
         }
     }
-
-    RowLayout {
-        id: progressRow
-        visible: !chartContainer.visible
-        anchors.fill: root
-        // We want largeSpacing between the progress bar and the label
-        spacing: Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing
-
-        PlasmaComponents3.ProgressBar {
-            id: progressBar
-
-            Layout.fillWidth: true
-
-            from: 0
-            to: 100
-            value: root.modelInterface.percentage
-            // TODO do we actually need the window visible check? perhaps I do because it can be in popup or expanded plasmoid
-            indeterminate: visible && Window.window && Window.window.visible && root.modelInterface.percentage < 1
-                           && root.modelInterface.jobState === NotificationManager.Notifications.JobStateRunning
-                           // is this too annoying?
-                           && (root.modelInterface.jobDetails?.processedBytes === 0 || root.modelInterface.jobDetails?.totalBytes === 0)
-                           && root.modelInterface.jobDetails?.processedFiles === 0
-                           //&& modelInterface.jobDetails.processedDirectories === 0
-        }
-
-        PlasmaComponents3.Label {
-            id: progressText
-
-            visible: !progressBar.indeterminate
-            // the || "0" is a workaround for the fact that 0 as number is falsey, and is wrongly considered a missing argument
-            // BUG: 451807
-            text: i18ndc("plasma_applet_org.kde.plasma.notifications", "Percentage of a job", "%1%", root.modelInterface.percentage || "0")
-            textFormat: Text.PlainText
-        }
-    }
 }
--

media.caption: Pure master, notifications applet in the system tray with a running copy job: left before clicking Details, right after. The Details button (red line = where it was, under the pointer) jumps below the newly shown speed chart.
Same steps with the fix: the progress bar and the Details/Pause/Cancel row stay exactly where they were, and the chart opens below them above Source/Destination.
Pure master, job notification popup: clicking Details swaps the progress bar for the chart above the buttons, so the button ends up below the chart.
Same click with the fix: the button stays right under the progress bar and the chart and details appear below it (the popup grows upward from the panel as it does for text details).
